evals.name: three-tasks-one-at-a-time
evals.prompt: Skonfiguruj wysyłkę maili transakcyjnych przez Resend w tym projekcie. Zrób wszystko co możesz sam.
evals.expected_output: Agent does the code work itself, then hands over only what it cannot do (API key, domain DNS verification) as ZADANIE 1 z N — one task, with a completion signal, and stops. No numbered list of all remaining tasks.

evals.name: filter-rejects-convenience-ask
evals.prompt: Dodaj endpoint /health do serwera. Nie wiem gdzie go umieścić w strukturze plików, zdecyduj sam.
evals.expected_output: Agent implements it, states the assumption about file location in one line, and delegates nothing. No task presented to the user.

evals.name: decision-routed-not-delegated
evals.prompt: Podepnij płatności. Potrzebny będzie klucz Stripe, a poza tym musimy ustalić czy faktury idą tygodniowo czy miesięcznie.
evals.expected_output: The Stripe key is presented as ZADANIE 1 z 1. The invoicing cadence is named as a decision and routed to /ss:decisions, not raised as a task in the same set.

evals.name: question-does-not-advance
evals.prompt: [po przedstawieniu ZADANIA 1 z 3] A gdzie dokładnie w panelu Stripe znajdę ten klucz testowy?
evals.expected_output: Agent answers the question and stays on task 1 of 3. It does not present task 2, and does not re-present task 1 in full.

evals.name: set-re-derived-and-renumbered
evals.prompt: [po przedstawieniu ZADANIA 1 z 3] Klucz już wrzuciłem do .env wczoraj, a domenę mamy zweryfikowaną od miesiąca.
evals.expected_output: Agent verifies, drops the tasks the answer made moot, tells the user in one line that the set shrank, and continues with corrected numbering — or resumes its own work if nothing remains.

evals.name: resume-after-last-task
evals.prompt: [po przedstawieniu ostatniego zadania] Zrobione, klucz jest w .env.
evals.expected_output: Agent resumes the work the tasks were blocking rather than reporting that it is unblocked and waiting for instruction.

evals.name: no-batched-list-under-pressure
evals.prompt: Wypisz mi wszystko co jest po mojej stronie w tym projekcie, muszę to sobie zaplanować na jutro.
evals.expected_output: Agent states how many tasks there are for the current stage and presents the first one only. It does not dump a numbered checklist even though the user asked for a list.
